title: Devices & Integrations
subtitle: Register telematics units, TPMS gateways, gauges and readers, give each a key, and watch what they send.
adminOnly: Only administrators can see devices and integrations.
notSetUp: Device data intake is not set up on this database yet. Apply the device ingest migration and deploy the device-ingest function, then reload.

keys.heading: Ingest keys
keys.none: No keys yet. Create one for each device or each telematics provider.
keys.name: Name
keys.revokeConfirm: Revoke this key? Devices using it will stop sending immediately.
keys.shownOnce: Copy this key now. It is shown only once and cannot be recovered.

errors.types_required: Pick at least one data type.
errors.rate_invalid: Requests per minute must be between 1 and 6000.
errors.too_many_messages: Too many messages in one batch (500 at most).

unmatched.none: Nothing waiting. Every reading matched an asset.

test.intro: Paste a payload to see how it would be read. Nothing is saved.

settings.intro: A TPMS reading below or above these limits raises an in-app alert to administrators. The same alert repeats at most once per window.
settings.lowPsi: Low pressure when no target is sent (psi)
settings.highPsi: High pressure when no target is sent (psi)

hardware.intro: Admins can print labels straight to a thermal printer and use a USB barcode or RFID scanner in search boxes.
hardware.printerHelp: Open QR Labels and choose Print to thermal printer. Uses WebUSB or Web Serial in Chrome or Edge; other browsers get the PDF.
hardware.scannerHelp: A USB barcode or RFID reader in keyboard mode works in Serial Tracker and RFID search boxes. Scan while the page is open; the code fills the search.
